title: ETHOS AND PATHOS IN ONLINE GROUP DISCUSSIONS: CORPORA FOR POLARISATION ISSUES IN SOCIAL MEDIA
reasoning: The paper focuses on identifying and annotating rhetorical strategies (ethos and pathos) in human-generated social media discussions to study polarization. While it uses Aristotelian categories that include 'moral virtue', the research is a linguistic and computational analysis of human discourse rather than an evaluation or benchmark of moral, ethical, or religious reasoning in AI systems.
